title: Full-screen AC video observations
details: Start Observation now opens a clean choice page for Written Observation, Video Observation or Witness Video Testimony
Video observations record the unit introduction first, then return to a free-order LO list
Each LO is one reduced-size video and the recording screen shows one AC at a time above a much larger full-screen camera preview
Competence is selected for the current AC before Next AC becomes available; pressing Next AC timestamps the next criterion inside that LO video
Competent with actions and Further evidence required reveal an action box while exact 100% wording matches are added automatically as partially observed mapped evidence without a competence decision
Witness video testimony is visible from the observation method page and can also be started after completing a direct video observation
The signed PDF lists every LO video and each AC timestamp, while the compressed ZIP contains the PDF, introduction and all LO videos
